purpose: Determine whether the enriched moving state (Wb,Wt,H) admits a no-fit physically interpretable closure for the internal flux qi at z=H-d, while retaining the supported BC2-B7 terminal qH reconstruction.

reference_qi.reconstruction: mean of qi_from_bulk and qi_from_terminal after their <=1e-10 cm/day identity gate

STANDARD_SPLIT_LARE.description: Published first-order layer-average interface closure applied to bulk and terminal storage averages.

TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR.description: Use the BC2-B7 mass-consistent terminal slope as the one-sided local interface gradient.

BULK_SIDE_LINEAR.description: Use both Wt and Wb to reconstruct a mass-consistent one-sided bulk slope anchored to the terminal-derived interface suction.
BULK_SIDE_LINEAR.coordinate: y=(H-d)-z, y=0 at internal interface and y=B at 90 cm
BULK_SIDE_LINEAR.admissible_slope_domain: b >= -psi_i/B so reconstructed suction is nonnegative throughout the bulk

consistency_diagnostic.interpretation: If the two mass-consistent one-sided slopes imply materially different qi, the enriched state does not define a unique local gradient under this piecewise-linear reconstruction.

hydrostatic_invariants.exact_state: For hydrostatic storage at any qualified H, a_t=1, psi_i=d, b=1.
hydrostatic_invariants.consequence: Both TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR and BULK_SIDE_LINEAR give qi=0.

time_alignment: Candidate endpoint qi values are trapezoid-averaged over each 0.0008-day Reference interval and compared with interval-average BC2-B8 qi.

adjudication.candidate_support_rule: A candidate receives qi-operator support only if it is defined on all accepted Reference states, has lower RMS and mean-absolute qi error than STANDARD_SPLIT_LARE and no greater sign-mismatch count in both WATER_TABLE_RISING and WATER_TABLE_FALLING, while being noninferior in HOLD.
adjudication.preferred_operator_rule: A unique preferred operator is declared only if one supported candidate is component-wise minimum or tied minimum for RMS and mean-absolute error and has minimum sign mismatches in all three direction strata.
adjudication.width_rule: No preferred d is declared unless the same width is supported by BC2-B7 qH and the B9 preferred qi operator is component-wise minimum/tied minimum across both widths in all three direction strata. Otherwise width remains unresolved.
adjudication.one_sided_consistency_rule: The terminal-vs-bulk one-sided mismatch is diagnostic and cannot be repaired by an empirical blend in B9.

next_if_supported: A later BC2-C dynamics work unit may propagate (Wb,Wt,H) using the B8 conservation laws, the supported B7 qH closure and the supported B9 qi closure. That requires its own preregistration and restart/domain tests.
